verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Haggai 2

Second oracle in October 520 at the feast; old men who had seen Solomon's Temple; Heb 12:26 quotes 2:6; "Desire of All Nations" read by ancient rabbis and Christians as the Messiah, though the word can mean "treasures"; the latter glory greater through Herod's remodelling and Jesus' presence (Trapp); clean/unclean ruling; Zerubbabel made like a signet ring — a token of royal authority
